searchText: I think it is under appreciated how many users are waiting for L2s that are actually censorship resistant and have security features on-par with L1. Optimistic rollups have the problem of needing to run a verifier, or trust that someone else is (and for all we know no one is). All L2s currently deployed (except Fuel) also have admin backdoors/upgradability as well. zkRollups would be ideal, but they are hard to build and StarkWare (the people who seem to be furthest along) are being weird about their open sourcing strategy and are still running a permissioned prover last I checked. Basically we want a row on this table that is white all the way across, and ideally has ZK proofs in the left most column: <https://l2beat.com/?view=risk> <@!301186049323958275> I love you too 🙂 We are not being weird about it. We just are just not talking about it publicly. I mean the licence is not particularly friendly to the community at large. I know I know. There is reasons behind it: I’m not sure the Boba/Metis/Optimism situation is actually beneficial for the community at large We need to protect our stuff until we know exactly how we want to do it. You get one shot at licensing and you cannot fuck it up Important correction: calldata heavy transactions do not necessarily mean 4488 I think it’s better to introduce separate tx type (no. 3) than repurpose what we have now
